description: This file contains template implementations of safe mathematical operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication) with support for compile-time checks and fallbacks, primarily for use in the Chromium project. It includes support detection for assembler-optimized routines and defines various operation structs.

classes.name: CheckedAddFastOp
classes.description: Template struct for checked addition operation supporting overflow detection.

classes.name: CheckedSubFastOp
classes.description: Template struct for checked subtraction operation supporting overflow detection.

classes.name: CheckedMulFastOp
classes.description: Template struct for checked multiplication operation with support detection for Clang.

classes.name: ClampedAddFastOp
classes.description: Template struct for clamped addition operation.

classes.name: ClampedSubFastOp
classes.description: Template struct for clamped subtraction operation.

classes.name: ClampedMulFastOp
classes.description: Template struct for clamped multiplication operation.

classes.name: ClampedNegFastOp
classes.description: Template struct for clamped negation operation.

methods.name: Do
methods.description: Performs the respective arithmetic operation, with support for overflow detection or clamping, depending on the struct.
